update budget_year
           set year = coalesce($3, year),
               start_date = coalesce($4, start_date),
               end_date = coalesce($5, end_date),
               sort_order = coalesce($6, sort_order),
               is_active = coalesce($7, is_active),
               updated_by = $2,
               updated_at = now()
           where id = $1 and deleted_at is null
